topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: They announced it at the meeting—my apartment building is converting to condos. The words hung in the air, heavy and ominous. Everyone seemed to murmur in vague shock, but I couldn’t move, couldn’t speak. My mind raced, calculations spinning out of control. How long before I have to leave? Where will I go? The walls of my little sanctuary felt like they were closing in, the comfort of my routine shattered. They talked about ‘options’ and ‘support,’ but all I could hear was the echo of change, unstoppable and looming. The room swam before my eyes, and I clutched my bag tighter, my knuckles white. I need to find another place, quickly, but where do I even start?
